limitations: No heavy scan or Docker operation was run alongside the root SQL workload.

Memory admission observes current available host memory, visible cgroupv2 ancestor headroom and inherited finite RLIMIT ceilings before each native command. It does not impose a new native hard memory cap or reserve memory against concurrent processes.
Darwin available memory conservatively sums free, inactive and speculative pages; unsupported/malformed accounting, cgroupv1 memory limits or less than6GiB available fail closed.

The first focused test execution had two fixture errors because RLIM_INFINITY is platform-dependent; fixtures now use the actual platform constant and all42 tests pass. No product/scan pass is inferred.

container.ramSemantics: CodeQL evaluator/extractor request, not a hard process cap

native.ramSemantics: CodeQL evaluator/extractor request, not a hard process cap

officialReferences.basis: Exit99 means CodeQL out of memory; physical RAM need not be exhausted.
--ram is a query-evaluator memory request, not a hard resident-memory ceiling.
